title: Word honours keepNext on empty paragraphs exactly like on text paragraphs
source: probe (PR #2418), A4 72pt margins, Arial 11 filler, Heading1 = keepNext + keepLines before 240 after 80 sz 32: 31 filler lines leave ~306pt; 11 empty Heading1 paragraphs (30.4pt each) + empty + anchor move whole to the next page (anchor baseline 433.2 = the text-heading control)

cases.note: the empty keepNext chain (334pt) does not fit the 306pt remainder and opens page 2 with the first heading
